title: Impact of Merged Career Tracks for Graduate and Non-graduate Civil Servants on Starting Salary, Career Progression and Exposure
what_it_is: Impact of Merged Career Tracks for Graduate and Non-graduate Civil Servants on Starting Salary, Career Progression and Exposure

sections.label: Entry-level pay and advancement
sections.summary: Entry-level pay is based on job responsibilities and qualities, with education used as a proxy where experience is lacking, and performance determining advancement.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: At the entry level, officers are paid based on their assigned job responsibilities and demonstrated qualities, which include leadership and relevant experience.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Where an officer does not have relevant work experience, in particular, for those just entering the workforce, their performance in their educational institutions, which includes both academic and non-academic accomplishments, will be taken into consideration as a proxy.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Once an officer is on the job, it is performance and readiness for bigger job responsibilities that matter.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: A non-graduate who has demonstrated the same qualities as a graduate will be given the same development and advancement opportunities.

sections.label: Scholarship recipients' assessment and CEP
sections.summary: Returning scholarship recipients are assessed and paid like non-scholarship recipients, with CEP based on demonstrated AIM qualities, not starting educational qualifications.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Once the scholarship recipients return from their studies, they are assessed and placed on the same schemes of service and their salaries are also determined in the same way as non-scholarship recipients.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: An officer's CEP is assessed based on demonstrated "AIM" qualities, which stand for (a) Analytical and Intellectual Capacity; (b) Influence and Collaboration; and (c) Motivation for Excellence.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The CEP assessment is not based on the officer's starting educational qualifications.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister (Mr Teo Chee Hean) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The Public Service Leadership Programme (PSLP) is one example of how officers with demonstrated performance and potential for higher responsibilities are developed.
